=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2706-2716 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The canonical-mount elif in "Pre-assemble static context (cacheable across runs)" exports CODEX_ISOLATED_STATIC_CONTEXT_FILES (and STATIC_CONTEXT_CANONICAL_SANDBOX_PATH) to GITHUB_ENV without checking the effective STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE. As a result, every later scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh run in the job (lines 611-629) still copies the canonical file (707,815 bytes, over 700 KB) and logs `CODEX_ISOLATION static_context files=1` even when the mode is inline.
  WHY: The documented inline rollback is incomplete. The logs show the index-mode mount as active, each implement, syntax-repair and diagnose attempt copies the file for nothing, and the new fail-closed `fail "static context file rejected"` path stays live and cannot be switched off. Every reviewer rated it NIT. The fix is to export only when the lowercased mode is empty or `index` (about 3 lines).
- tests/test_static_context_agents_index_implement.py:Test run failures | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push test gate fails with 41 failures on the PR head, including the newly introduced tests.
  WHY: This means the changes are unverified on the current head and the new implementation does not pass its own contract tests. The source rated it BLOCKER. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped it as unmappable to any diff site: check-runs had failed_count 0 with collection_status timeout, and the failures looked environmental.
- tests/test_static_context_agents_index_clarify_plan.py:159-178 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: test_implement_phase_honours_switch() checks implement-phase behaviour but sits in the clarify_plan test suite.
  WHY: It mixes test suites, which makes the tests confusing to organise and harder to maintain. The source rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it: the test existed in that file before this PR, and the file documents the star-import CI wiring at lines 13-15.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If either engine path cannot receive the include, keep inlining the canonical file for that run (fail safe to today's prompt) and log why." (Issue #8262, Change item 2)
  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh lines 678 (`diagnose_codex_cmd=(bash "${CODEX_ISOLATED_EXEC}" run --mode read-only --)`) and 687-693 (Claude `claude_run` branch)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR has no hunk in scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh. The `diagnose_codex_cmd` literal passes no `--include`, the Claude `claude_run` call sets no `AI_ENGINE_INCLUDE_PATHS`, and the diagnose run logs no `canonical_reason`/`fallback=inline` line. The diagnose launch lacks the include setup and fallbacks used in implement.yml, so in the default index mode its static prefix points at `/support/static-context/agents_canonical.md`, which reviewers say is not mounted there. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it: the diagnose step is in the same job (implement.yml:6825), so it inherits the GITHUB_ENV export, and the copy loop (611-629) and `/support` mount (636) in codex_isolated_exec.sh do not depend on `--mode`.
- requirement: Plan D3 (docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md lines 44-49): "all ##/### headings, plus bullet-level entries for the 6 sections over 30 KB, with line ranges."
  expected_change_site: scripts/build_static_context.sh, the canonical branch of emit_agents_index and heading_lines (H2 regex at line 532, canonical emit around lines 580-712)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/build_static_context.sh line 532 has `H2 = re.compile(r"^##\s+(.*?)\s*$")`, and heading_lines() appends only those matches. Line 580 calls heading_lines(text, known) for both modes. Lines 705-712 emit "=== CANONICAL AGENTS.MD INDEX (coding-workflows) ===" with no canonical-specific ### headings or bullet indexing, so the canonical index has no ### headings and no bullet entries for the large sections. The PR description and changelog do not mention the deviation. minimax rated it MAJOR and luna NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it as phase-1 emitter behaviour inherited under the issue's "the same emitter" directive.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:lines 2706-2716, the "Pre-assemble static context (cacheable across runs)" step | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rollback switch only works partly. With STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE=inline, or an unrecognised value that `_static_context_agents_mode` (scripts/build_static_context.sh:470-484) maps to inline, the elif still exports CODEX_ISOLATED_STATIC_CONTEXT_FILES. Later codex_isolated_exec.sh runs then enter the copy loop (lines 611-629), log `CODEX_ISOLATION static_context files=1`, and keep `fail "static context file rejected"` active. This affects the implement attempts (implement.yml:3477), syntax-repair (implement.yml:4723) and diagnose (implement.yml:6825).
  WHY: During a documented inline rollback, log analysis reports the mount as active, and a fault in the copy path cannot be disabled through the switch. The trigger is narrow and this is not a live failure. Fix: export only when the lowercased mode is empty or `index` (about 3 lines).
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh line 626, `workspace_py copy-include "${static_context_src}" "${root}/support/static-context/${static_context_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "static context file rejected"`. The `2>&1` throws away copy_include's rejection reason, unlike lines 668 and 671. Fix: drop `2>&1` (1 line). Also .github/workflows/implement.yml lines 2709-2716: add a `mode_lc` lowercase guard `{ [ -z "$mode_lc" ] || [ "$mode_lc" = index ]; } &&` to the elif (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE (rejected pass-1 items):
  - The STATIC_CONTEXT_SIZE format did not change for all phases; `canonical=` is added only inside the implement branch.
  - The test placement is fine: test_implement_phase_honours_switch was there before this PR, and the star import is deliberate (ci.yml:2540).
  - The diagnose task gap is invalid: the variable is inherited via GITHUB_ENV in the same job (implement.yml:6825), and implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:674-678 uses the same helper; the copy loop (611-629) and `/support` mount (636) do not depend on mode, and the Claude path goes through codex_isolated_exec.sh (ai_engine.sh:469, 560).
  - The plan D3 gap is invalid: issue #8262 says "the same emitter, pointed at that path".
  - The pre-push gate concern is not reported: unrelated files in the gate, check-runs timed out.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
